conversion.original_title: 小型请求响应协议只在每次发送分成两个小write时出现固定延迟，怎样分析Nagle与延迟ACK的交互？

body:
## 操作任务
实现send_request(sock,parts)，sock是调用者拥有的已连接TCP套接字，parts是按序产生的非空bytes片段迭代器：后续片段可能等待服务端消费首片段，因此禁止先耗尽迭代器再合并。仅在本次发送期间启用该套接字TCP_NODELAY，将片段依次sendall并返回实际发送字节总数；总预算65536字节，空序列/空片段/非bytes/超预算抛ValueError，不发送当前无效片段。成功、生成器异常或发送异常均恢复原TCP_NODELAY，不关闭套接字、不改KEEPALIVE/缓冲区或宿主参数，异常不得被当成成功。此前已发送的前缀无法撤回，调用方需按协议丢弃不完整请求，不能将TCP写入当事务。验收真实Nagle+延迟ACK约40毫秒等待、仅改NODELAY和仅改QUICKACK两组控制，再验收学员函数在带NUL的流式片段下恢复低延迟及原设置。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Linux回环TCP，使用自身socket的TCP_QUICKACK=0控制接收端延迟ACK，TCP_INFO实际观测首段尚未确认；与NODELAY=1和QUICKACK=1独立控制比较中位数和真实完整字节，不用sleep伪造网络延迟。QUICKACK是非永久的Linux提示，内核不呈现因果特征时该环境待验证，不能套用固定延迟判生产故障。不修改sysctl/防火墙/默认网络，不要求抓包特权，不构建镜像；不声称NODELAY永远提高吞吐，整报文已知时可以合并写入，但本题是流式依赖。套接字须由调用者独占，未覆盖共享socket并发配置恢复。

test_files.checks/nagle_fixture.py:
"""Controlled Linux loopback sockets; no sysctls, packet injection, or host networking changes."""
import json,socket,struct,threading,time

def trial(nodelay=0,quickack=0):
    ready=threading.Event();first=threading.Event();out={};errors=[]
    listener=socket.socket();listener.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));listener.listen(1)
    def serve():
        try:
            with listener.accept()[0] as peer:
                peer.settimeout(2);peer.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP,socket.TCP_QUICKACK,quickack);ready.set()
                head=peer.recv(1);assert head==b'A'
                out['prefix_received_ns']=time.monotonic_ns();first.set()
                tail=b''
                while len(tail)<3:tail+=peer.recv(3-len(tail))
                out['body']=head+tail;out['tail_received_ns']=time.monotonic_ns()
                peer.sendall(b'OK')
        except BaseException as exc:errors.append(repr(exc));ready.set();first.set()
    thread=threading.Thread(target=serve);thread.start()
    try:
        with socket.create_connection(listener.getsockname(),timeout=2) as client:
            client.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP,socket.TCP_NODELAY,nodelay)
            assert ready.wait(2)
            client.sendall(b'A');assert first.wait(2)
            out['unacked_before_tail']=struct.unpack_from('I',client.getsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP,socket.TCP_INFO,104),24)[0]
            out['tail_sent_ns']=time.monotonic_ns();client.sendall(b'BCD')
            out['reply']=client.recv(2);out['reply_received_ns']=time.monotonic_ns()
    finally:
        listener.close();thread.join(3)
    assert not thread.is_alive() and not errors,errors
    out['tail_delay_ms']=(out['tail_received_ns']-out['tail_sent_ns'])/1e6
    out['body']=out['body'].decode();out['reply']=out['reply'].decode()
    return out

if __name__=='__main__':
    print(json.dumps({mode:[trial(*settings) for _ in range(5)] for mode,settings in
        [('nagle_delayed',(0,0)),('nodelay_delayed',(1,0)),('nagle_quick',(0,1))]}))
test_files.checks/check.py:
import json,pathlib,socket,statistics,struct,sys,threading,time
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path("checks").resolve()))
from nagle_fixture import trial
print("NATIVE_LINUX_READY",flush=True)
import task
print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: per-socket Nagle mitigation and option restoration",flush=True)
controls={mode:[trial(*settings) for _ in range(3)] for mode,settings in
 [("nagle_delayed",(0,0)),("nodelay_delayed",(1,0)),("nagle_quick",(0,1))]}
slow=controls["nagle_delayed"];fast=controls["nodelay_delayed"]+controls["nagle_quick"]
assert all(row["body"]=="ABCD" and row["reply"]=="OK" for rows in controls.values() for row in rows)
assert all(row["unacked_before_tail"]==1 for row in slow)
assert statistics.median(row["tail_delay_ms"] for row in slow)>20
assert statistics.median(row["tail_delay_ms"] for row in fast)<15
assert statistics.median(row["tail_delay_ms"] for row in slow)>5*max(.01,statistics.median(row["tail_delay_ms"] for row in fast))
print("NATIVE_NAGLE_DELAYED_ACK_ACTUAL_UNACKED_SEGMENT_AND_TWO_CAUSAL_SOCKET_CONTROLS "+json.dumps(controls),flush=True)
def checked(previous=0,error=False):
 listener=socket.socket();listener.bind(("127.0.0.1",0));listener.listen(1)
 ready=threading.Event();first=threading.Event();out={};errors=[]
 def serve():
  try:
   with listener.accept()[0] as peer:
    peer.settimeout(2);peer.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP,socket.TCP_QUICKACK,0);ready.set()
    assert peer.recv(1)==b"A"
    first.set()
    if error:
     while peer.recv(1024):pass
    else:
     body=b""
     while len(body)<4:
      part=peer.recv(4-len(body));assert part;body+=part
     out["body"]=body;out["tail_received_ns"]=time.monotonic_ns();peer.sendall(b"OK")
  except BaseException as exc:errors.append(repr(exc));ready.set();first.set()
 thread=threading.Thread(target=serve);thread.start()
 try:
  with socket.create_connection(listener.getsockname(),timeout=2) as client:
   assert ready.wait(2);client.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP,socket.TCP_NODELAY,previous)
   unchanged={option:client.getsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,option) for option in [socket.SO_KEEPALIVE,socket.SO_SNDBUF,socket.SO_RCVBUF]}
   def fragments():
    yield b"A"
    assert first.wait(2),"streaming source waits for first fragment consumption"
    out["unacked_before_tail"]=struct.unpack_from("I",client.getsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP,socket.TCP_INFO,104),24)[0]
    if error:raise OSError("controlled producer failure after prefix")
    out["tail_sent_ns"]=time.monotonic_ns()
    yield b"B\x00CD"
   if error:
    try:task.send_request(client,fragments())
    except OSError as exc:assert str(exc)=="controlled producer failure after prefix"
    else:raise AssertionError("source failure reported as success")
   else:
    assert task.send_request(client,fragments())==5
    assert client.recv(2)==b"OK"
    out["delay_ms"]=(out["tail_received_ns"]-out["tail_sent_ns"])/1e6
    assert out["body"]==b"B\x00CD" and out["unacked_before_tail"]==1
   assert client.getsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP,socket.TCP_NODELAY)==previous,"original per-socket setting was not restored"
   assert unchanged=={option:client.getsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,option) for option in unchanged}
   assert client.fileno()>=0
 finally:
  listener.close();thread.join(3)
 assert not thread.is_alive() and not errors,errors
 return {key:value for key,value in out.items() if key!="body"}
rows=[checked() for _ in range(3)]
assert statistics.median(row["delay_ms"] for row in rows)<15
checked(1);checked(0,True);checked(1,True)
with socket.socket() as client:
 client.setsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP,socket.TCP_NODELAY,0)
 for parts in [[],["text"],[b""],[b"x"*65537]]:
  try:task.send_request(client,iter(parts))
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError("invalid input accepted")
  assert client.getsockopt(socket.IPPROTO_TCP,socket.TCP_NODELAY)==0
print("NATIVE_STUDENT_STREAMING_BINARY_REQUEST_LOW_LATENCY_ORIGINAL_OPTION_RESTORED_ON_SUCCESS_AND_SOURCE_FAILURE "+json.dumps(rows),flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
